scrap_pile.description: One pilot's junk is another pilot's... also junk.

rust_pile.description: Whatever this used to be, it's mostly rust now. The rust seems happy about it.

lamp.description: Still burning on yard power. Nobody remembers paying the bill.

blue_lamp.description: A blue marker lamp. It used to guide loaders home; now it guides pilots.

puddle.description: Black, slick and faintly rainbowed. Something up the line is still leaking.

coolant_puddle.description: Coolant, pooled where the pipes gave up. Too thin to siphon from, but it smells of hard work.

sign.description: The warning has faded away. It was probably important.

dead_tree.description: It's been dead longer than I've been printed. Neither of us is complaining.

crate.description: Sealed tight and stencilled in a fleet code nobody reads any more. Probably bolts.

barrel.description: Hazard stripes on a rusted drum. Empty, I hope.

girder.description: A hull girder from the shipbreaking days, left exactly where it dropped.

pipe.description: It gurgles now and then. I'd rather not know what with.

tire.description: Too heavy to roll, too stubborn to rot.

bones.description: Real bones, from something that was born. Nobody here was born.

crystal.description: Ichor that seeped up and set hard over the years. It still glows like the pools it came from.

mushroom.description: A fungus that glows to lure in insects. There are no insects. It glows anyway.

banner.description: The colours of a crew that left a long time ago.

console.description: Still scrolling a build queue for mechs that were finished forty years ago.

conveyor.description: It delivered its last part decades ago and hasn't noticed.

furnace_glow.description: Slag from the last pour. Forty years on and it still hasn't quite cooled.

skull.description: The head of a fallen walker. Its eye lamps still glow red on emergency power.

antenna.description: A small relay mast, still blinking. The last thing it passed on was the order to HOLD.

boulder.description: Too big to move, too dull to salvage. It has outlasted everything around it.

rock_spire.description: Wind and grit have been carving at it for longer than anyone has kept records.

scrub_tree.description: Something green that grew here on its own. Nobody planted it.

pine.description: It keeps its needles all year. Up here, there isn't much else to keep.

titan_skull.description: A titan's head, half buried. Something behind the visor is still running.

titan_ribs.description: The frame of a titan's chest. Whatever sat in there walked out, or didn't.

titan_arm.description: A titan's arm, still reaching for something it never got hold of.
